'''G'hhurrlha''', a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]], was a famous [[Big game hunter/Legends|big-game hunter]] who collected many trophies across many worlds. Under the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], he took advantage of the reduced conservation and protection of [[Sentience/Legends|nonsentient]] [[species]] and traveled from hunting ground to hunting ground.<ref name="ETO" />

[[File:Widow_Maker_GG10.png|thumb|right|200px|An Explorer Scout Ship like G'hhurrlha's]]
The Wookiee hunter roamed [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in a stripped-down [["Explorer" Scout Ship|Explorer Scout Ship]], and G'hhurrlha customized the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] with skulls, [[Bone/Legends|bones]] and [[Chitin/Legends|chitin]] shells from his various hunting expeditions. The main room was decorated with mounted heads of [[Krayt dragon/Legends|Krayt dragons]], adult [[Acklay/Legends|acklay]], and [[Lylek/Legends|lyleks]] lining the walls. In a corner, a [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]] table set into a preserved [[Bull rancor/Legends|bull rancor]] head sat on [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Wampa/Legends|wanpa-skin]] rug.<ref name="ETO" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|First and foremost, the career gains three new specializations: the Archeologist, Big Game Hunter, and Driver.|[[Fantasy Flight Games]], describing new backgrounds like the Big-game Hunter that G'hhurrlha exemplified.|<ref name="Website">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2013/12/6/explore-all-the-galaxy-has-to-offer|text=Explore All the Galaxy Has to Offer}}</ref>}}
G'hhurrlha was mentioned in ''[[Enter the Unknown]]'',<ref name="ETO" /> the [[2013]] official rules supplement for the [[Scout/Legends|Explorer]] career in the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[roleplaying game]] developed by [[Andrew Fischer]].<ref name="Website" />
